title: Turn
description: Whose turn it is and what they may do. On the map actor is always the Scribe. In a fight, actor is null and available_actions empty once the fight is over. While a Scribe's fight turn runs, time_left_ms and reserve_left_ms say how long it has, measured when the message is sent: durations, because the client's clock may be off. On the map they are absent.

time_left_ms.description: Time left in this turn before the reserve starts to run.

reserve_left_ms.description: The Scribe's reserve for the rest of the fight. When both reach 0 the server ends the turn (turn_timed_out).
